summary: The replay matches through step 45, then stops at step 46 because preflight_dotrap() refuses SQKY_BOARD before the hero trap effect runs. The source-owned gap is the missing hero arm of trap.c:trapeffect_sqky_board(); JavaScript already has the monster arm, selector, dotrap() caller path, and mon.c:wake_nearby() helper. Complete the whole trap function and admit this supported trap through the dotrap preflight gates.

source.branch: For the hero arm (mtmp == &gy.youmonst), compute forcetrap from FORCETRAP, FAILEDUNTRAP, or Flying with VIASITTING. If the hero is levitating or flying without forcetrap, reveal the board and report a crease/loose board only when not blind; do not squeak or wake monsters. Otherwise reveal the trap, play the selected note when tnote is valid, report a vibration when Deaf or a squeak message otherwise, then call wake_nearby(FALSE). The assigned case reaches the ordinary non-flying, non-levitating path on a newly wished board; C shows the squeak and wakes the nearby sleeping goblin. The existing monster arm remains part of this whole function. To make the full hero source path reachable, preflight_dotrap() must admit SQKY_BOARD through its trap-type, already-seen-trap, and mounted-hero guards; dotrap() already implements the corresponding common source branches.
callers: hack.c:spoteffects calls trap.c:dotrap when the hero arrives on a trap square; dotrap passes the hero to trap.c:trapeffect_selector.
trap.c:trapeffect_selector dispatches SQKY_BOARD to trapeffect_sqky_board for both hero and monster actors.
trap.c:mintrap calls trap.c:trapeffect_selector when a monster steps onto a trap; the existing JavaScript function already implements this monster arm.
dependencies: trap.c:trapnote formats the board note and trap.c:seetrap reveals it; both have JavaScript implementations in js/trap_effects.js.
mon.c:wake_nearby(FALSE) wakes monsters within u.ulevel * 20 squared-distance units without angering them; js/mon.js already implements this helper and calls wake_nearto_core.
The branch reads Levitation, Flying, Blind, Hallucination, Deaf, trap->tnote, and FORCETRAP/FAILEDUNTRAP/VIASITTING state.
The existing monster arm depends on m_in_air, canseemon, mindless, couldsee, mdistu, trapnote, and mon.c:wake_nearto; their current JavaScript support remains in js/trap_effects.js and js/mon.js.
Soundeffect selects the board note but does not write to the terminal screen captured by the session recorder.
